title: Special Executive Masters Program In Supply Chain Management
description: Dive into the forefront of global commerce with our Special Executive Masters Program in Supply Chain Management, where cutting-edge strategies meet real-world logistics challenges to propel your career to new heights.
longDescription: The Special Executive Masters Program in Supply Chain Management aims to equip professionals with advanced knowledge and strategic skills in logistics, procurement, and supply chain optimization. This program empowers graduates to lead and innovate in the fast-evolving field of supply chain management, driving efficiency and competitiveness in global markets. The Programme offers an efficient approach to learning beyond traditional classrooms. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The Special Executive Masters Program In Supply Chain Management allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. This programme aims to deliver a practical and realistic skill-based study programme to enhance your understanding of the supply chain and logistics function, its challenges and key strategies for success, which is supported by appropriate reference to theoretical and conceptual analysis.
courseDetails: The Special Executive Masters Program In Supply Chain Management qualification aims to develop a deep understanding of the concepts, strategies and analytics for successful supply chain and logistics planning, design and implementation. Course Details: Supply Chain Management: Explore modern supply chain management's core principles and practices, focusing on the efficient and effective flow of goods and services. Global Business Enterprise: Gain insights into the dynamics of international commerce and the impact of global trends on supply chain strategies. Managing Logistic Operations: Learn to oversee and streamline logistic operations to ensure smooth and cost-effective transportation, storage, and distribution of goods. Operations Sustainability: Understand how sustainability practices can be integrated into supply chain operations to promote environmental responsibility and ethical sourcing. Procurement Management: Dive into the procurement process, from sourcing to vendor management, focusing on building strong supplier relationships and optimizing costs. Research Methods: Acquire the skills to conduct rigorous research in supply chain management, analyzing data to inform strategic decisions and identify opportunities for improvement. Assessment: GP Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project(GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in Supply Chain Management and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

modules.title: PROCUREMENT MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The module seeks to provide learners with a thorough understanding of procurement and supply management from a strategic, technological, process and relationship perspective. The goal is to provide insights on the role of procurement within supply chain management, the tools and techniques to assess sourcing options, the negotiation and contractual issues encountered with suppliers, effective supplier relationship management and technological enablers in procurement.
